title: 外国語特別科目（Ｇｌｏｂａｌ　Ｅｎｇｌｉｓｈｅｓ）（夏期集中講義）
subtitle: Special Subject - Foreign Languages(Global Englishes)
courseType: （Provided by all courses）Liberal Arts CoursesTransdisciplinary Learning
educationalGoal: In Global Englishes, students will explore global uses of English, focusing on Japan. Students build vocabulary, listening, and speaking skills while learning how English reflects culture. They gain confidence communicating in international and intercultural contexts.
advice:
This course helps students learn how English is used in different countries and cultures. Students will study different English accents, local vocabulary, and how to speak in a culturally appropriate way.

The course will focus on:

a) Varieties of English around the world
b) Common expressions in different countries
c) Listening and speaking using global media
d) Communicative strategies for real situations

Students will practice English through discussions, role-plays, and presentations. They will learn how to use English in international situations and become more confident speaking with people from other cultures.

Before each class, students must study materials provided by the teacher.

activityGoals.body: Learn how English is used in many countries worldwide.
Learn English in Japan and other world regions.
Present with global Englishes, adapting to various contexts.
Explore English varieties in media to understand cultures.
Become an independent learner by exploring English varieties.

achievementLevels.ideal:
1.The students will be able to fully understand how English is used in different countries.
2.The students will be able to effectively use vocabulary and expressions from various English varieties.
3.The students will be able to present ideas fluently, using global English styles with cultural awareness.
4.The students will be able to speak confidently using global English styles in everyday situations, in a culturally sensitive and appropriate manner.
achievementLevels.standard:
1.The students will be able to understand how English is used in different countries.
2.The students will be able to use some vocabulary and expressions from a range of English varieties, with some mistakes.
3.The students will be able to present basic ideas using global English styles and cultural awareness.
4.The students will be able to speak using global English styles in everyday situations, in a socially appropriate manner.

              授業の概要および学習上の助言

              This course helps students learn how English is used in different countries and cultures. Students will study different English accents, local vocabulary, and how to speak in a culturally appropriate way.

The course will focus on:

a) Varieties of English around the world
b) Common expressions in different countries
c) Listening and speaking using global media
d) Communicative strategies for real situations

Students will practice English through discussions, role-plays, and presentations. They will learn how to use English in international situations and become more confident speaking with people from other cultures.

Before each class, students must study materials provided by the teacher.
